additional_info.subject: ID0387566-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197002] Failsafemode_Active CRM:00921001272
additional_info.body:
Hello Andre Sousa Albino,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Beerpal
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R3 313020197002
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
6F5Ze7
Problem Description
: Failsafemode_Active
Troubleshooting
:
Despite rebooting the charger from the backend, it remains in failsafe mode.
Please carry out the following steps:
Perform a hard reset on the charger.
Check the connection on the 24V DC bridge terminal to ensure it is not causing any power supply issues to SECC.
Verify that the router's Ethernet port or Ethernet switch port is not loose.
Inspect for any loose connections to the OCPP router and the LAN cable of the router.
Connect with MobaXterm and check for device scans to identify any devices that are not responding.
Continuous reboots and subsequent entry into Failsafe Mode can be attributed to several causes:
One of the FW components (PLC, Router, SECC, ...) is not reachable
RJ45 connector not properly connected on one of the devices
PLC not reachable (e.g. CFastCard corrupted) (Note: this would not notify FailsafeMode in the Error-Flags, since the PLC is not working in this case)
Any software service failing to start.
Additionally, I am providing a link to a knowledge article for your reference; please review it.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_PLC,SECC_Failsafe mode error - Dynamics 365
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387566
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Beerpal Singh

additional_info.subject: ID0387566-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197002] Failsafemode_Active CRM:00921001272
additional_info.body:
Olá André, bom dia.
Ontem conseguimos resolver o problem do Failsafemode. Inicialmente, o Router 2 estava com as configurações de fábrica. Quando tentámos repor as configurações originais e fazer reboot ao carregador, as definições de fábrica voltaram, portanto algo errado se passa com o Router e não conseguimos fazer esse tipo de troubleshoot.
Depois de instalarmos o novo router, funcionou imediatamente (apenas um precalço onde precisámos da password antiga do router), mas apareceu outro erro onde não conseguiamos ver as error-flags apesar de termos logs.
Assim, utilizámos o LiveLinux para restaurar as configurações originais do carregador e funcionou!
Já está o v3.2.8 instalado e a funcionar. Como expliquei ao João, apesar de aparecer no frontend que as outlets estão em erro:
Nos logs conseguimos ver claramente que estão a funcionar:
Sabemos que isto é um bug raro do SCB mas não afeta a operabilidade do carregador visto que podemos confirmar sempre nos logs. O João também já fez o download da v4.0.11 para a pen, portanto isso agora fica do vosso lado.
Por mim está tudo resolvido e podemos fechar o ticket.
Aguardarei o vosso feedback antes de fechar o ticket.
Muito obrigado!
Best regards,
Francisco
